_doc: Per-company application caps. We apply to at most `max` distinct roles at one company within any rolling `window_days` period (counts PENDING + SUBMITTED-within-window). This respects employer application-limit policies (e.g. Roblox auto-closes >5 in 30 days) and Greenhouse/Workday duplicate-applicant dedup. Reach comes from breadth (many companies), NOT depth at one employer. Override a company by name (normalized: lowercased) in `overrides`. `exempt` = staffing agencies/marketplaces where each posting is a different end-client, so the anti-spam rule doesn't apply.

_known_hard_limits.roblox: 5 applications per 30 days (auto-closes the 6th) — confirmed via no-reply@roblox.com 2026-06-18; we cap at 4 for a safety margin.
